basics.headline: Staff Distributed Systems Engineer & Certified Cloud Architect

summary: Distinguished infrastructure engineer with 14 years of expertise designing globally distributed databases, automated workflow orchestrators, and enterprise office platforms serving tens of millions of active users worldwide.

experience.title: Staff Platform Architect

Orchestrated migration of 4,000 microservices to unified service mesh with zero unplanned downtime.
Pioneered automated chaos engineering practices that reduced multi-region recovery times by 68%.
Mentored twenty-four staff and principal engineers across platform and core reliability divisions.

experience.title: Principal Software Architect
